options.name: detailed
options.description: return more in-depth settings for default subdictionary of firewall_config. Matches the structure of the custom subdictionary if this is active.

options.name: online
options.description: When true, use the D-Bus API to query the status from the running system. Otherwise, use firewall-offline-cmd(1). Offline mode is (currently) incompatible with "detailed" mode.
